messages.en:
{07 1b 00}I'd almost forgotten that 
we were going to play
hide-and-seek today!
I was so overcome by my 
desire to {04 22 00}
that I forgot to invite you!
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Ma peaaegu unustasin, et
me pidime täna peitust
mängima!
Mind haaras nii suur soov
{04 22 00},
et unustasin sind kutsuda!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Ugh!{01 00 00 14 00} A day can go by so
quickly, you barely even
notice until it's night!
{07 16 00}I was hoping to play
hide-and-seek with you
today,
{07 1b 00}but it got dark before I
had a chance to ask,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Öök!{01 00 00 14 00} Päev võib nii kiiresti
mööduda, et sa vaevu
märkad, kuni on öö!
{07 16 00}Ma lootsin täna sinuga
peitust
mängida,
{07 1b 00}aga läks pimedaks, enne kui
jõudsin küsida,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Playing hide-and-seek
at night sounds fun,

{07 1b 00}but I think it's almost
time for you to go to bed.

{07 14 00}I'll ask you next time,{01 00 00 05 00}
when it's bright out,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Öösel peitust mängida
kõlab lõbusalt,

{07 1b 00}aga ma arvan, et sul on
peaaegu magamamineku aeg.

{07 14 00}Ma küsin järgmine kord,{01 00 00 05 00}
kui väljas on valge,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
